note: 高價值主題例句・短金句諺語：自寫+查證，待獨立 reviewer 複查出處。

items.sentence: Practice makes perfect.
Better late than never.
Actions speak louder than words.
Honesty is the best policy.
Look before you leap.
The early bird catches the worm.
Where there's a will, there's a way.
Don't judge a book by its cover.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
Two heads are better than one.
A picture is worth a thousand words.
All that glitters is not gold.
items.zh: 閃閃發光的未必都是金子。

items.sentence: Slow and steady wins the race.
Haste makes waste.
Necessity is the mother of invention.
No pain, no gain.
Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
items.zh: 蛋還沒孵就別數小雞（別打如意算盤）。

items.sentence: Great minds think alike.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
items.zh: 美醜因人而異（情人眼裡出西施）。

items.sentence: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
Patience is a virtue.
Better safe than sorry.
Hope for the best, prepare for the worst.
items.zh: 抱最好的希望，做最壞的打算。

items.sentence: Fortune favors the bold.
Laughter is the best medicine.
I have a dream.
The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
items.zh: 我們唯一要恐懼的，就是恐懼本身。

items.sentence: To be, or not to be.
All the world's a stage.
items.zh: 整個世界就是一座舞台。

items.sentence: I think, therefore I am.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
items.zh: 未經省察的人生不值得活。

items.sentence: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
Knowledge is power.
Time is money.
items.attribution: Benjamin Franklin (Advice to a Young Tradesman, 1748)

items.sentence: Well done is better than well said.
Keep calm and carry on.
Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
items.zh: 像蝴蝶般飛舞，像蜜蜂般螫刺。

items.sentence: The pen is mightier than the sword.
A watched pot never boils.
items.zh: 心急水不沸（愈盯著愈慢）。

items.sentence: Make hay while the sun shines.
The grass is always greener on the other side.
Out of sight, out of mind.
When the going gets tough, the tough get going.
A penny saved is a penny earned.
items.zh: 省一分錢就是賺一分錢。

items.sentence: Measure twice, cut once.
items.zh: 量兩次，剪一次（謀定後動）。

items.sentence: You can't have your cake and eat it too.
Birds of a feather flock together.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
When one door closes, another opens.
items.zh: 一扇門關了，另一扇門會開。

items.sentence: Easy come, easy go.
The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.
items.zh: 有其父必有其子（龍生龍，鳳生鳳）。

items.sentence: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
items.zh: 別把雞蛋放在同一個籃子裡。

items.sentence: Too many cooks spoil the broth.
items.zh: 廚子太多反壞了湯（人多反誤事）。

items.sentence: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
items.zh: 一天一蘋果，醫生遠離我。

items.sentence: Don't cry over spilled milk.
Strike while the iron is hot.
Blood is thicker than water.
Good things come to those who wait.
items.zh: 好事總降臨在懂得等待的人身上。

items.sentence: Absence makes the heart grow fonder.
items.zh: 距離使情更深（小別勝新婚）。

items.sentence: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
items.zh: 一鳥在手，勝過二鳥在林。

items.sentence: Don't put the cart before the horse.
When life gives you lemons, make lemonade.
items.zh: 逆境給你檸檬，就做成檸檬汁（化危機為轉機）。

items.sentence: It's never too late to learn.
Seeing is believing.
Silence is golden.
The best things in life are free.
items.zh: 人生最美好的事物都是免費的。

items.sentence: You reap what you sow.
Two wrongs don't make a right.
Stay hungry, stay foolish.
items.attribution: Steve Jobs (2005 Stanford commencement, quoting the Whole Earth Catalog)

items.sentence: May the Force be with you.
To infinity and beyond!
Life is like a box of chocolates.
That's all, folks!
Not all those who wander are lost.
items.zh: 流浪的人未必都迷失了方向。
items.attribution: J.R.R. Tolkien (The Fellowship of the Ring)

items.sentence: Curiouser and curiouser!
The truth is rarely pure and never simple.
items.zh: 真相很少是純粹的，也從不簡單。
items.attribution: Oscar Wilde (The Importance of Being Earnest)

items.sentence: Experience is the name everyone gives to their mistakes.
items.zh: 經驗是人人為自己的錯誤所取的名字。

items.sentence: Seize the day.
Less is more.
items.attribution: popularized by architect Ludwig Mies van der Rohe

items.sentence: Form follows function.
The medium is the message.
A thing of beauty is a joy forever.
items.zh: 美好的事物是永恆的喜悅。

items.sentence: To err is human.
A little learning is a dangerous thing.
Hope springs eternal.
And miles to go before I sleep.
items.zh: 還要走許多路才能安歇。
items.attribution: Robert Frost (Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening)

items.sentence: Good fences make good neighbors.
Hope is the thing with feathers.
items.zh: 希望是長著羽毛的東西。

items.sentence: I wandered lonely as a cloud.
items.zh: 我像一朵雲般孤獨地漫遊。

items.sentence: A rose by any other name would smell as sweet.
items.zh: 玫瑰即使換個名字，依然芬芳。

items.sentence: Brevity is the soul of wit.
items.zh: 言以簡為貴（簡潔是智慧的靈魂）。

items.sentence: What's done is done.
We are such stuff as dreams are made on.
items.zh: 我們是夢所構成的材料。

items.sentence: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
items.zh: 預測未來最好的方法就是創造它。

items.sentence: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
items.zh: 空談無用，拿程式碼來看。

items.sentence: That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
items.zh: 這是個人的一小步，卻是人類的一大步。

items.sentence: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
items.zh: 天才是一分靈感加九十九分努力。

items.sentence: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
